component.name: NexusDeck
component.summary: Lightweight Nexus Mods client for Steam Deck and Linux

description.p: NexusDeck is a controller-friendly Nexus Mods client built for Steam Deck and desktop Linux. Browse, download, and install mods with a console-like UI.
Fallout 4 is the first fully supported game.
Flatpak-only Linux distribution for Steam Deck.
